The guide states the default run-state pair is mongodb-local unless STORAGE_BACKEND=postgres.

Before teardown the stack had rag-params-finder-frontend, rag-params-finder-server, rag-params-finder-mongodb-local, rag-params-finder-elasticsearch-local (9.5.0), and rag-params-finder-postgres-local. cross_backend_overlap_full_grid.method: Slice 38 shape: match (retriever type, chunking_method, chunk_size, overlap, whitespace-normalized query_text, persona_id); SHA1 of whitespace-normalized chunk text; mean |A∩B|/3. Retriever type is retrievers[0].type. retrieval_method is not used, because cross_encoder runs store retrieval_method dense and would overwrite dense keys.
cross_backend_overlap_full_grid.grid: example-local shape: 5 chunking methods x 3 chunk sizes x 2 overlaps x 4 retrievers = 120 runs. Retrievers are dense, sparse, hybrid, and cross_encoder (local MiniLM).

cross_backend_overlap_full_grid.caveat: Dense is the comparability figure the scenario asks for. Postgres sparse is mostly empty results, so its overlap near 0.007 is an empty-list result, not a rank disagreement. MongoDB dense returned no hits for 285 of 2310 query-runs, which pulls its dense overlap with the other two stores down from the postgres-elasticsearch figure.
